u=$(id -u); echo "user manager delegates: $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-$u.slice/user@$u.service/cgroup.controllers)"; echo "cgroup v2: $(test -e /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers && echo yes || echo no)"
